messages:
Olivia Chen: quick heads up — telemetry shows a spike for tenant `acme-inc` right after we flipped per-tenant ratebanding on auth-proxy at 06:07 :eyes:
Carl Park: yup saw that. QPS to /v1/generate jumped x2 around 06:10. Not all tenants, just `acme-inc`. Could be a client-side retry pattern + different token routing.
Samir Nair: did we also change quota buckets? the rollout was supposed to only change routing policy, not per-tenant quotas.
June: rollout notes from earlier: "enable per-tenant ratebanding + sticky routing to project key" — we did add a new routing header `x-tenant-bucket` in the proxy.
Tracey: @Samir we didn't touch quota calc, but proxy now assigns requests to tenant-specific ratebands before quota lookup. That ordering could cause misattribution.
Olivia Chen: here's the quick kql I ran for the spike: ```requests | where path startswith "/v1/" and tenant=="acme-inc" | summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1m)``` output attached in the dashboard link.
Carl Park: quick triage idea — revert sticky routing for acme-inc only (flagged config) and watch if spike subsides. Canary was global, but we can flip per-tenant via console now.
June: i can flag `acme-inc` to fallback-to-global-routing in config service. Doing it in 2 mins.
infra-bot: deploy trigger accepted for feature-flag: routing.fallback.acme-inc -> ON (run id: d-7839)
Tracey: FYI if we fallback we lose the per-tenant batching gains (higher cost) but should restore expected quota behavior. Tradeoff noted.
Samir Nair: also let's add a telemetry metric: `auth.proxy.routing_path` tag to token-level logs so downstream quota service can correlate routing decision with enforcement. Right now logs don't include decision path.
Olivia Chen: agreed. Also want a quick dashboard card showing "requests routed to tenant-bucket vs global" by tenant so product can watch rollouts.
Carl Park: adding alert: if any tenant's routed_qps / baseline_qps > 1.5 for >5m after rollout, page eng-platform. Simple anomaly rule.
June: rollback done for acme-inc, spike already dropping in graphs :thumbsup: 
infra-bot: metric flush: routing.decisions updated for tenant=acme-inc, new tag attached to logs.
Tracey: follow-ups: 1) change routing->quota ordering OR 2) ensure quota service uses original project key mapping even when proxy routes to tenant-bucket. Preference 2 for minimal perf impact.
Samir Nair: preference 2 also — cheaper and safer. I'll prototype a compatibility header `x-original-project` that proxy forwards to quota service.
Olivia Chen: timeline: can we get the header + telemetry in staging today and a small canary tomorrow? Keep the per-tenant rollout paused until confirmed.
Carl Park: yep. I'll update the rollout doc in /docs/rollouts/authz-routing and add the per-tenant toggle instructions.
June: filing a short postmortem note in incidents channel with links to dashboards and the rollback timestamp.
Olivia Chen: thanks all — solid coordination. Will follow up with stakeholder note for `acme-inc` later today.
